name: point
purpose: A dot on its axis. On a state input the learner drags it; on a derived value it only shows where the value is.
binds: number (number line) or two numbers x and y
keys: arrows or WASD one step, ⇧ for ten steps

bind.doc: number line: the state key of x

y.doc: the key of y, on x/y axes

drag.doc: false makes an input point still; a point on a derived value never drags

show.doc: show the value beside the label
